info.bio: Mayhem es una banda de Black metal noruego que se formó en 1984. La formación original del grupo consistía en Manheim en la batería, Euronymous en la guitarra y Necrobutcher al bajo. El nombre de la banda fue tomado del título de una canción de Venom llamada "Mayhem With Mercy". Mucha controversia rodeó a la banda en sus inicios, varios asesinatos, suicidios y otras formas de violencia. Mayhem ha pasado por una gran variedad de estilos dentro del Black Metal

scenes.name: Black metal noruego
scenes.book: Heavy Metal: The Music and Its Culture
scenes.author: Deena Weinstein
scenes.desc: El término viene de una canción de Venom, pero en los noventa ya no designa una temática sino un estilo sonoro nacido en Noruega con Mayhem y Burzum: sobre una base de death metal añade capas de teclados cósmicos, voces chirriantes y músicos pintados de cadáver. Sus fundadores se tomaban en serio el satanismo: profanaciones de cementerios, iglesias quemadas y asesinatos que, como los antecedentes de los gangsta rappers, le dieron un aire de autenticidad. Crece exponencialmente en el norte de Europa (Emperor y Dimmu Borgir ya cruzan el Atlántico) y a su vez se fragmenta hacia lo new age (Tiamat, Burzum) o hacia el gótico (Cradle of Filth, Theatre of Tragedy).

scenes.name: Metal de los noventa: progresivo, death y black metal
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Si los ochenta fueron la edad de oro del heavy metal, los noventa lo fragmentan en estilos que amplían ideas anteriores. El pop-metal (Warrant, Extreme, Live) es lo menos significativo; Marilyn Manson casa el scum-rock de Alice Cooper con el industrial de Nine Inch Nails. El metal progresivo (Warrior Soul, Dream Theater, Royal Hunt, Opeth, los suizos Alboth!). El death metal muta en algo más terrible y más musical gracias a Brutal Truth, Cannibal Corpse y, sobre todo, la tríada de Type O Negative (Slow Deep And Hard, misas negras wagnerianas), Today Is The Day y Fear Factory; Biohazard, Coalesce, Dillinger Escape Plan. El nuevo black metal escandinavo: Entombed, Darkthrone, Immortal, Mayhem, Enslaved, Emperor, Satyricon, Cradle Of Filth.

podcast.title: Band Member Murdering Another
podcast.body: Mayhem is cited as the only known instance where one band member murdered another. This occurred when Varg Vikernes killed his bandmate Øystein Aarseth (Euronymous) on August 10, 1993, following disputes over the band's direction and philosophical points concerning the Norwegian black metal scene. "Marways Mayhem, the only time I know of, where one band member murdered another."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Euronymous's Murder
podcast.body: The band's leader, Euronymous, was murdered in 1993 by Varg Vikernes (Burzum). This event is considered one of the darkest episodes in Black Metal history. "En las esquinatoes 1993 de Orónimos, Líber de Maigen."

podcast.title: Extreme Inter-Band Violence and Murder
podcast.body: Mayhem was involved in what is described as the "most violent rock feud of them all." After bandmate "Dead" committed suicide, members Varg Vikernes and Euronymous argued over what to do with fragments of Dead's skull. Euronymous proposed making a necklace from them and blowing up a cathedral in Dead's honor. Vikernes, who disagreed with these ideas, became convinced Euronymous was plotting to kill him. This led Vikernes to stab Euronymous 23 times, resulting in Vikernes's arrest and imprisonment. "Two members, Varg Vicarness and Uranamis, argued over what to do with the pieces of skull blown off. When bandmate Dead, seriously, that was his name, Dead, committed suicide."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Mayhem is an incredibly scary and murderous Norwegian black metal band, whose story is so insane it requires its own dedicated exploration. "Mayhem, the incredibly scary and murderous Norwegian black metal band."

podcast.body: A member of the band Mayhem was murdered by Vargh Vikernes of Burzum, who stabbed the victim 23 times. "Vargh Vicarans of the band Burzum stabbed a guy in a rival band called Mayhem 23 times. And yes, he died."

podcast.body: Euronymous, the lead singer of the black metal band Mayhem, committed a horrific act by murdering a bandmate and subsequently consuming a portion of his brain. "Uranamis, the lead singer of the black metal band Mayhem, who murdered a bandmate and then ate part of his brain."

xref.title: Early Band Formations
xref.body: In the early 1990s, Matt Bellamy was the guitarist for drummer Dominic Howard's high school band, Carnage Mayhem, which subsequently became Gothic Plague. He later joined Dominic and another member in a band called Rocket Baby Dolls, which, at a teacher's suggestion, changed its name to Muse. "Matt Bellmi then became the guitarist for drummer Dominic Howard's band Carnage Mayhem, which then became known as Gothic Plague."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Early Band Formations
xref.body: In the early 1990s, Dominic Howard was the drummer for his high school band Carnage Mayhem, which included Matt Bellamy on guitar and later became Gothic Plague. He then formed Rocket Baby Dolls with Matt and another member, which eventually became Muse after a teacher's suggestion. "Matt Bellmi then became the guitarist for drummer Dominic Howard's band Carnage Mayhem, which then became known as Gothic Plague."

xref.title: Murder of Mayhem Member
xref.body: Vargh Vikernes of the band Burzum was convicted for stabbing a member of the rival band Mayhem 23 times, which resulted in the victim's death. For this crime, he was sentenced to 21 years in jail. "Vargh Vicarans of the band Burzum stabbed a guy in a rival band called Mayhem 23 times. And yes, he died."

xref.title: Murdered by Bandmate Varg Vikernes
xref.body: Øystein Aarseth, known as Euronymous, from the Norwegian death metal band Mayhem, was murdered on August 10, 1993. His bandmate, Varg Vikernes, went to Euronymous's apartment in Oslo, ostensibly to discuss a contract, which escalated into a fight. Vikernes stabbed Euronymous to death with 23 cuts: two to the head, five to the neck, and sixteen in the back. "On August 10th, 1993, Vickers went to Euronymous's apartment in Oslo, ostensibly to talk to him about a contract. There was a fight, and Vickers stabbed Euronymous to death with 23 cuts, 23."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Tour Excesses
xref.body: Led Zeppelin's tours were legendary for their excesses, involving private jets, groupies, and extensive drug use, often cited as an example of rock and roll mayhem. "The Who Trashing Hotel Rooms led Zeppelin's tours with their private jet groupies and tons of drugs."
